thread:
dmitri: FYI — proposing a coordinated rollout: runtime v3.2.1 + router r8.4 at 22:00 UTC tonight. Need API and Console checks before we lock the window. Runtime includes a KV-eviction behavior change that might affect active sessions.

deploy-bot: scheduled: start=2026-11-04T22:00:00Z, stage=canary->gradual, target=runtime:v3.2.1,router:r8.4. Automated health checks enabled. Respond with "ack" to confirm.

alice: ack. I'll run the API contract smoke and the integration harness at 21:10 UTC. Will post results.

ben: quick Q — does the runtime change mutate prefix caches? If so we should version the cache key.

dmitri: good call. It changes eviction policy only, not key schema. But there is a short overlap where prefetched KV entries might be evicted sooner. Plan: keep old runtime in canary group for 15m, monitor tail latency and 5xx rate.

carol: rollback criteria proposal: >0.5% client 5xx across api-route:generate for 5m OR tail latency p99 spike >200ms vs baseline for 3m -> immediate rollback. Also if Console errors for any user-facing render flows.

eva: Console needs a feature-flag toggle for the new router headers (x-rw-route-v). I'll push the flag to staging and confirm toggle-by-request works. ETA 20:45 UTC.

ops-runner: capacity note: router r8.4 requires a minor bump to connection pools on the T4 fleet; autoscaler set to +10% headroom for first hour. I've wired the alert to #oncall.

ben: thanks — can you add a short-lived metric for kv_eviction.rate so we can correlate cache misses to tail latency?

ops-runner: added metric: infra.kv.eviction.rate (1m agg) and a dashboard tile. Alert threshold: >200 evictions/min sustained 3m.

alice: API smoke passed on staging: no contract diffs, 0 new 5xx in 30m. Runbook snippet I'm going to use:```sh
# canary deploy command
deployctl rollout --service runtime --version v3.2.1 --canary 5 --wait 15m
deployctl rollout --service router --version r8.4 --canary 5 --wait 15m
```

dmitri: nice. Two operational asks before we lock: 1) Console flag ready, 2) API has a fallback route to old runtime for session-lookups (feature flag path). If both yes, i'll mark go at 21:30.

eva: Console flag pushed to prod as off, verified toggle flip works in 2s.

alice: API fallback route is on a config toggle; works in staging. I'm enabling it as a precaution at 21:40 UTC.

carol: added the rollback runbook snippet to the release notes: `rollback -> deployctl rollback --to tag runtime-v3.2.0 && router-r8.3`. Also included steps to invalidate session cache if needed.

deploy-bot: ack received from participants: 6. Lock window candidate set for 22:00 UTC. Please post final go/no-go by 21:30 UTC.

ben: one last note — ensure the model-serving route in runtime has header parity; missing header mapping caused a previous edge-case. I'll validate headers at 21:20.

ops-runner: confirmed header parity test added to the smoke suite (integration-harness/headers.check).

alice: final: API, Console, Infra checks all green. I'm toggling API fallback at 21:40 and will be on pager. Go from my side.

dmitri: go for me. I'll be coordinating the canary gate and watching kv_eviction & p99. If anything trips, we stop the rollout and follow rollback steps.

deploy-bot: deploy runbook pinned to thread. Canary start at 22:00 UTC. Notifying oncall at 21:55 UTC.

carol: quick reminder in case we need fast rollback: use the immediate rollback CLI with --no-confirm to save time. Put a short note in #oncall so they know.

ops-runner: noted and added to the oncall playbook. Also I’ll keep a 30-min maintenance chat open for cross-team coordination. Link: https://zoom.company/maint-4132105555

dmitri: thanks all — closing prep. I’ll post canary metrics snapshots at +5m and +15m. Everyone stay on standby until 23:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
